citations.quote:
[name="菈塔托丝"]……
[name="菈塔托丝"]啧。
[Character(name="avg_npc_253_1#7$1")]
[name="菈塔托丝"]阿克托斯。
[Character(name="avg_npc_254_1#7$1")]
[name="阿克托斯"]干什么？
[Character(name="avg_npc_253_1#8$1")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="菈塔托丝"]你是相信我，还是相信恩希欧迪斯？！
[Character(name="avg_npc_254_1#7$1")]
[name="阿克托斯"]你们两个，我一个都不相信！
[Character(name="avg_npc_253_1#8$1")]
[name="菈塔托丝"]那你至少也该知道，眼下谁才是敌人！
[name="菈塔托丝"]布朗陶家的战士们，准备战斗！
[Dialog]
[Character]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_soldiersrun")]
[Character(name="avg_npc_285_1#1$1", name2="avg_npc_285_1#1$1",fadetime=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[Character(name="avg_npc_253_1#8$1")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="菈塔托丝"]先救出休露丝，再把恩希欧迪斯给我拿下！
[Character(name="avg_npc_285_1#1$1", name2="avg_npc_285_1#1$1")]
[name="布朗陶家战士"]是！
[Character(name="avg_npc_254_1#8$1")]
[name="阿克托斯"]……*谢拉格俚语*，佩尔罗契家的战士们，列阵！
[Dialog]
[Character]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_soldiersrun")]
[Character(name="avg_npc_286_1#1$1", name2="avg_npc_286_1#1$1",fadetime=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[Character(name="avg_npc_254_1#8$1")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="阿克托斯"]把恩希欧迪斯这个逆贼拿下！让民众们知道，他才是那个叛徒！
[Character(name="avg_npc_260_1#6$1")]
[name="古罗"]是！
[Character(name="avg_npc_286_1#1$1", name2="avg_npc_286_1#1$1")]
[name="佩尔罗契家战士"]是！
[Character(name="avg_172_svrash_1#1$1")]
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]锏。
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]把诺希斯押下去。
[Character(name="avg_npc_257_1#2$1")]
[name="锏"]不用我？
[Character(name="avg_172_svrash_1#1$1")]
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]不用。
[Character(name="avg_npc_257_1#1$1")]
[name="锏"]行吧。
[Character(name="avg_172_svrash_1#1$1")]
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]角峰。
[Dialog]
[Character]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[Character(name="avg_199_yak_1#6$1",fadetime=1.5)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[name="角峰"]在。
[Character(name="avg_172_svrash_1#1$1")]
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]照看住大长老和圣女大人。
[Character(name="avg_199_yak_1#6$1")]
[name="角峰"]是。
[Character(name="avg_172_svrash_1#1$1")]
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]魏斯。
[Dialog]
[Character]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[Character(name="avg_198_blackd_1#9$1",fadetime=1.5)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[name="魏斯"]在。
[Character(name="avg_172_svrash_1#1$1")]
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]把阿克托斯与菈塔托丝拿下。
[name="恩希欧迪斯"]尽量不要出人命，现在还不是时候。
[Character(name="avg_198_blackd_1#9$1")]
[name="魏斯"]是。
